sections.body: Some words sound the same at the end. They RHYME! 🎵
Cat 🐱 and hat 🎩 rhyme. Cat… hat… they both end with 'at'.
Say these out loud: bee 🐝, tree 🌳, me! Do they rhyme?
Read the questions aloud. Stretch the ending sounds (c-AT, h-AT). Nursery rhymes and songs are a great way to practise rhyming every day.

hints: Say SUN out loud. Listen to the end.
Sun ends with 'un'. Which one ends with 'un' too?
Look: cat and hat both end with 'at'. Find a word that ends like sun.
quiz.explain: Sun and bun both end with 'un'! ☀️🍞

hints: Bee and tree rhyme because they end with 'ee'. Which animal ends with 'og'?
quiz.explain: Frog and dog both end with 'og'! 🐸🐶
